richiami.difetto: Possibility due to incorrect air pipe layout that parking brake can not be reapplied when entrance door is opened from the outside. Vehicle could run away.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles check for incorrect tapping of auxiliary air supply from between the parking brake control and the spring brake unit. Transfer the auxiliary air supply connection to a safe source where necessary.

richiami.difetto: Some instances of fracture of the leg on Vogel seats have occurred on the coaches concerned.
richiami.rimedio: Owners of potentially affected coaches will be contacted by AVE Berkhof and requested to examine the seat legs. Where they are broken or show signs of impending failure replacements will be supplied by AVE Berkhof. Where legs are intact a kit to reinforce
